description: This file defines the FileStorage class which manages file download and upload queues, encryption, and file existence checks within the Notesnook project. It interacts with external services for file operations and handles event publishing for file activities.

classes.name: FileStorage
classes.description: Manages file download/upload queues, encryption, and file operations with event handling within the Notesnook project.

methods.name: queueDownloads
methods.description: Queues multiple files for download, manages download groups, and publishes events.

methods.name: queueUploads
methods.description: Queues multiple files for upload, manages upload groups, and publishes events.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a specific file within a group, with duplicate check and event publishing.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels all ongoing uploads and downloads within a specified group.

methods.name: readEncrypted
methods.description: Reads an encrypted file with specified encryption key and cipher data.

methods.name: writeEncryptedBase64
methods.description: Encrypts data and writes it as a Base64 string with specified MIME type.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file locally or from remote storage.

methods.name: hashBase64
methods.description: Generates a Base64 hash of the input data.

methods.name: getUploadedFileSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of an uploaded file.
